Callout.Name: Fire at a Substation
Callout.Advisory: Power company on the way, area being cleared.

Script.Line: It is the substation and there is oil in those units.
The power company is twenty minutes out and I cannot hold that fence forever.
Nobody goes in there. I have told everybody twice.

Lines.Approach: It is the substation and the power company is twenty minutes out. Keep everybody back from the fence.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
